7.3 Internal behavior
The internal operation of the CAN Transport Layer provides basic mechanisms in order to perform the main purpose of this module, which is to transfer messages in a single CAN frame or in multiple CAN frames. The entire behavior of the CAN Transport Layer will be event triggered, so that CanTp can processes transfer of N-SDU (respectively L-SDU) coming from the PDU Router (respectively CAN Interface) directly.
